response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rental_count FROM rental AS r JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film AS f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), rating_shares AS (SELECT rental_count, rental_count / SUM(rental_count) OVER () AS share FROM rating_counts), compared AS (SELECT rental_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM rating_shares) SELECT SUM(rental_count) AS kept_count, AVG(share) AS average_kept_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
